title: Categorical Bar Chart
description: Vertical bars for 2–6 categories with labeled axes and optional value labels. Serves Problem-Solving and Data Analysis (one-variable-data, ratios-rates-proportions, percentages): reading values, comparing categories, and computing percent change from the figure.

categories.description: One bar per category, drawn left to right in array order.

value.description: Bar height; strictly positive so no zero-height bar can appear.

yAxisMax.description: Top of the y-axis; must be >= the largest value (renderer validates) and is snapped up to a clean tick multiple.

yTickStep.description: Gridline step; null lets the renderer choose a clean step (1/2/5 × 10^n).

showValues.description: Print each value above its bar. Set false when the question asks students to read values off the axis.

notes: Renderer guarantees: bars never overlap (width auto-computed from category count), duplicate category labels are rejected at parse time, y-axis starts at 0 (no misleading truncation), and bar heights are exactly proportional to value / yAxisMax.
